display_long_description:
Ape Lab is a horror themed VR fan game inspired by Hand Movement unique locomotion. Step into a twisted laboratory where failed experiments roam the shadows. Using your arms to climb, run, and escape, you must survive terrifying encounters in a world built to test your nerves.

🧟 Features:
• Horror Atmosphere Dark, creepy environments filled with unsettling sounds.
• Tag with a Twist The classic Hand movement, but now survival means staying out of reach of the monsters.
• Multiplayer Suspense Scream and laugh with friends as you try to escape together.
• Dynamic Locomotion Climb walls, swing across obstacles, and use every surface to your advantage.

Ape Lab mixes the fun of “Being An Ape” with the fear of survival horror. Whether you’re exploring alone or with friends, the question is simple: how long can you last before the lab takes you?
